property_summary: For every caller address, only the stored smartfix_owner is allowed to successfully invoke sudicideAnyone() (so non-owners cannot cause the call to succeed); the mutant removes that owner check so there exists some non-owner caller for which sudicideAnyone() succeeds (the reference always prevents non-owners).
change_summary: Replace the require check to allow anyone to call sudicideAnyone (removes owner restriction), so selfdestruct can be invoked by any caller.
